## Findings refused / left as is
- Unit 0 ዕልዋን "the Perverse (?)" and ወነገረ "the Case of": a guess, already hedged in l, i and note; cannot be improved without Dillmann.
- Unit 2 ዕፀ መንበር, unit 4 ኰሳኵሰ "peeled (?)", unit 5 ከተማ "tip (?)", unit 12 ምምሕፃነ "womb (?)", unit 23 ጥልቀት "stain (?)", unit 29 ይሜግቦ/ያሰፍኖ/አስትቶ: all hedged in i and note; kept.
- Unit 5 and unit 25: Joseph bowing to Jacob's staff (Genesis 47:31 and Hebrews 11:21 have Jacob bowing). Source slip or the author's reading; the notes say so and keep it as printed. Kept.
- Unit 7 ሰማርያ and ሐዲስ ታቦት; unit 18–19 "father and mother"; unit 26 Moses' rod (Aaron in Exodus); unit 11 ው ፡ እቱ split: all flagged in the notes as source slips and kept as printed. Kept.
- Unit 12 ምስካይ "city of refuge" without (?): the house entry is hedged, but Numbers 35 makes the reading secure in this phrase, and the note says so. Kept.
- Unit 16 and others: ንስግድ rendered "bow", where the known entry (ch. 28, 36, 64–65, 91) says "we worship". Published parts use both (ch. 64–65 "bow to her"); ሰገደ is literally "bow down", the note in unit 16 explains the choice, and the argument of the chapter (reverence versus worship) is better served by the literal verb. Kept; the gloss entry should be broadened ("bow").
- Capital "Law" (unit 7, now also 14–15) against lower-case "law" in units 9, 11 and in published ch. 64–65: the pilot has "Ark of the Law of God", later parts vary. I aligned only the two edited places; the rest left, as a style point.
- Unit 10 "Adam's first error" and "salvation" for መድኀኒት: agree with house entries. Kept.
- Unit 19 "and He said" twice (ወይቤ ... ወይቤ): i keeps both; the Geʿez has both. Kept.
- Unit 20/32 present-tense English for ዘ + perfect ("whoever believes and is baptized", "those who love Him"): generic ዘ, as accepted in ch. 103 pass 1. Kept.
- Unit 23 ተቀደሰ with ታቦት (masculine verb, feminine noun): the subject is not stated and the clause may be impersonal; not worth a note. Kept.
- Unit 25 "are to be consecrated" for ከመ ይትቄደሱ (l "they-are-consecrated"): a jussive after ከመ, "are to be" is sound. Kept.
- Unit 28 and 29: the drafter's readings of ይመውእ, ይሜግቦ, ወያሰፍኖ stay hedged; not resolvable here.
- Unit 30 ኢትሌቡኑ "plural-looking shape": already flagged as a form kept as printed. Kept.
- Unit 17 ሊቀ ጳጳሳት "chief of the bishops": fine; "patriarch" is the drafter's gloss in the note only.
- The `about` paragraph: accurate to the units; unchanged.

## For the gloss pass (not touched here)
- እምትካት: the known entry (from the foundation, from of old (?)) does not cover units 8 and 10 ("in turn (?)", l keeps ትካት); broaden.
- ንስግድ: known "we worship"; broaden with "we bow". መርጡል: known "uncertain; epithet of the tent"; unit 21 reading "martyrium (?)" must be added. ሜጣ (unit 24) is 3ms perfect + -ኣ; ሀሎ, ስመዑ, ፈላሲ ያን (slip) and ው ፡ እቱ (slip) need entries that say what was printed.
- አስተማሰላ: ast- stem of መሰለ + dative -ላ, not the object -ኣ.
